Only these combinations are supported. Use Theme Lab to inspect one row at a
time—never side-by-side theme matrices in the product UI.

## Supported rows

| Theme | Mode | Solid | Glass |
|-------|------|-------|-------|
| Forest | light | yes | yes |
| Forest | dark | yes | yes |
| Tide | light | yes | yes |
| Tide | dark | yes | yes |
| Graphite | light | yes | yes |
| Graphite | dark | yes | yes |
| Dune | light | yes | yes |
| Clay | light | yes | yes |
| Ember | dark | yes | yes |

## Motion overlay

Every row above can run with motion `on` or `off`. `prefers-reduced-motion`
forces the off path.

## Checklist

When reviewing visuals, confirm:

1. Accent remains singular and unsaturated
2. Glass keeps an opaque fallback
3. Dark packs use softer inner refraction edges
4. Numbers in tables stay tabular
5. Hit targets remain at least 40×40px
